from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class CompanyNetProfit(BaseModel):
    """Financial performance data extracted from a single company's 2025 Q1 report."""
    company_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="Full name of the listed company")
    stock_code: Optional[str] = Field(description="Stock market code of the company")
    net_profit: Optional[float] = Field(description="Net profit attributable to shareholders for 2025 Q1. Use negative numbers for losses.")
    currency: str = Field(default="CNY", description="Currency of the financial data")
    period: str = Field(default="2025-Q1", description="Reporting period")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated extraction results for the collection of financial reports."""
    company_net_profits: list[CompanyNetProfit]
